source_refs.note: 'Predictive Outcomes in Machine Learning' under topic 6.9, as printed (PDF 88, printed 84).

blocks.text: Predictive outcomes are results produced by a trained model. The model uses past data to make predictions. These outcomes estimate future values or events. Prediction accuracy depends on data quality. Good training improves predictions. For example, businesses use predictions for forecasting the market or product selling trends. Healthcare uses predictions for diagnosis. Predictions support better decisions.
